recommendations.issue: Inconsistent food preparation and lack of strict quality control in the kitchen.
recommendations.action: Implement a 'Recipe & Quality Control Program'. This includes: 1) Updating/creating detailed, standardized recipes with precise measurements and cooking times for all menu items. 2) Conducting mandatory, hands-on training for all kitchen staff on these new standards. 3) Establishing a daily pre-service tasting panel (Head Chef + Sous Chef) to evaluate consistency and quality of key dishes.
recommendations.expected_impact: A significant and immediate improvement in the consistency of taste, presentation, and overall quality of dishes, directly addressing customer dissatisfaction and building trust.

recommendations.action: Conduct a comprehensive 'Supplier & Ingredient Quality Audit'. This involves: 1) Reviewing all current food suppliers and their contracts. 2) Establishing clear, measurable quality specifications for all incoming ingredients. 3) Implementing a strict receiving checklist for daily deliveries, empowering staff to reject ingredients that do not meet specified standards.
recommendations.expected_impact: Ensures a higher baseline quality for all raw materials, reducing variability and elevating the overall quality of prepared dishes.

recommendations.issue: Lack of strict quality control in the kitchen (final output).
recommendations.action: Implement a 'Final Plate Inspection Protocol'. Designate a senior kitchen staff member (e.g., Sous Chef or Expediter) to visually inspect every dish for presentation, correct temperature, and portion size before it leaves the kitchen pass.
recommendations.expected_impact: Acts as a final safeguard, catching any last-minute inconsistencies or errors before they reach the customer, reinforcing quality standards.
